clips.title: The story
paras: Jansen Stead lies just west of the Elwynn border, where Defias bandits and mechanical Harvest Watchers now roam its fields.

Jansen Stead lies beside the road from Elwynn into Westfall. The farm once fed the kingdom, but unrest has driven its family from the land. Now Harvest Watchers, mechanical constructs associated with the Defias Brotherhood, patrol the fields alongside brigands. Couriers and travelers between Goldshire and Sentinel Hill pass close by.
